constraints.startingWeapon: must occur in the selected inventory and selectableAsStartingWeapon must be true
constraints.capacity: sum(original requiredAbility of all non-empty items) <= original character ability + local rank bonus
constraints.rankStatBonuses: none: ranks do not modify health, native damage, armor or movement

heavyCombination.rule: Do not combine machine-guns (16/17) with launchers (4/21/22), including looted inventory.

dualCannon.description: 중화기 병장부터 판져파우스트·바주카 2종. 쌍안경과 경량 자동화기 1개만 함께 허용하며 권총·근접·수류탄·방어·회복 장비는 포기합니다.

itemIdMapping.detail: HUD item-ID/name arrays: past stack+0x78/+0x83c; future stack+0x48/+0xbc. Native Korean kill strings 0x537a00..0x537cd0.

damageLookup.meaning: Raw lookup called by native hit processing; hit region, armor and explosion paths can alter final damage. This is not damage per trigger pull.

evidence.costs: Original shop bitmap label 필요능력치. Values unchanged. Original server-side spending enforcement has not been recovered.
evidence.characterStats: Original charInfo bitmaps: 방어력, 민첩성, 능력치. Role labels and allowed lists are new local rules.

item50.name: 쌍안경
item50.nativeEvidence: 0x461979..0x46198c gives IDs50/51 special handling (-1 model selector); 0x4619af..0x4619d1 excludes them from ordinary weapon-switch action. Optical utility identity is confirmed by the bitmap; actual 2x optical effect was not re-tested.

uncertainties: The seven-byte order is confirmed; original slot-specific item restrictions are not. UI slot labels and substitutions here are proposed local rules pending native runtime verification.
The original offline inventory puts crossbow6 and FG4210 in slots2/3. Changing slot2 to pistol1 is a new initial-loadout choice, not an original default.
Only MP38(9) and crossbow(6) have been individually verified in live LAN firing at the time of this document.
Shop power values sometimes differ from executable lookup. Show them as original shop display values, never as measured final damage.
Weapon points are exact shipped display values; role restrictions, ranks, XP thresholds, and rank budget bonuses are new local designs.
Future-age weapons and characters below are research appendix only and are excluded from this age0 UI proposal.

Fast characters' lower original capacity and heavy characters' larger capacity remain native individuality. Newly proposed role restrictions are untested balance choices, not a claim of equal combat strength.

balanceNotes: Every camp has assault, sniper and heavy starters at 0 XP; additional character variants unlock at 1000/3000/6000/10000 XP.
Original item points and original character capacity stay unchanged; rank grants only existing budget bonuses, never damage, HP or speed buffs.
Dual cannon is an explicit heavy-class 6000 XP unlock, not a budget loophole. Panzerfaust 21 + Bazooka 22 + MP38 9 + binocular 50 costs 1405.
Two-cannon restrictions continue after enemy weapon pickup. A single looted weapon may cross the initial class restriction, subject to points and heavy-combination constraints.
Different character variants retain the shipped character data. Tier unlock is not an extra stat buff.
